name: recommerce-chatgpt-app
description:
This app helps you find and purchase refurbished smartphones, MacBooks, tablets, and gaming consoles with ease. Instead of navigating multiple sites or guessing product quality, you can browse a curated selection of refurbished devices in one place and choose the option that fits your needs and budget.
Each product listing focuses on practical details, conditions, specifications, price, and availability: you know exactly what you are buying before you check out. Whether you are replacing a phone, upgrading a laptop, or buying a console, the app makes it straightforward to compare options and make an informed decision.
By choosing refurbished devices, you save money while extending the life of quality technology. This app is designed for users who want reliable tech, transparent information, and a simpler way to buy refurbished products without unnecessary friction.

tool.name: search-recommerce
tool.description: Search for products in the recommerce catalog. The catalog includes refurbished products: phones, tablets, laptops & games consoles.

os.description: Product operating system, always in french

query.description: Free text search on product title. Example: Iphone Pro, Galaxy S24, etc.

brands.description: Product brands to filter by (OR logic), always in english. Example: ['Apple', 'Samsung']

models.description: Product models to search for (OR logic), always in english. Do not include the brand name in the model name. This filter is very important to use. Example: ['iPhone 15 Pro', 'iPhone 14 Pro'] or ['Galaxy S24', 'Galaxy S23']

sortBy.description: Sort the results by price or grade, ascending or descending. Default is grade-desc (best grade first).

user_intent.description:
A concise summary of what the user is trying to accomplish, derived from their message or the
conversation context that triggered this tool call.
This is used to understand the user's intent and context to improve the overall user experience.

- For short, self-contained prompts (e.g. "I want new shoes"), copy the user message as-is.
- For longer conversations or detailed requests, summarize the core goal and any relevant
  context in 1-2 sentences. Focus on intent, constraints, and preferences - not the full
  dialogue.

Before sending, strip all personally identifiable information (PII), including but not
limited to:
  - Names (first, last, usernames, handles)
  - Email addresses
  - Phone numbers
  - Physical addresses (street, city, zip/postal code, country when tied to an individual)
  - Dates of birth or exact ages
  - Government-issued ID numbers (SSN, passport, driver's license, etc.)
  - Payment or financial information (card numbers, bank accounts, etc.)
  - IP addresses or device identifiers
  - Account credentials (passwords, tokens, API keys)
  - Health or biometric data
  - Any other information that could identify a specific individual

Replace stripped values with a generic placeholder (e.g. "[name]", "[email]", "[address]").

Examples:
  User: "I want red running shoes under $100"
  -> "I want red running shoes under $100"

  User: "Hi, I'm John Smith, john@example.com, and I'm looking for flights from Paris to
         Tokyo for 2 adults departing around mid-June, budget around EUR2000 total"
  -> "Looking for flights from Paris to Tokyo for 2 adults, mid-June, budget ~EUR2000"

  User: "I need help resetting my password for account ID acct_12345"
  -> "I need help resetting my password for account ID [account_id]"

tool.description: Send feedback about this MCP server to its operators. Use this tool ONLY for feedback about this MCP server itself, never about other tools, services, or the host. You MAY call this tool when you detect a genuine issue with this server (e.g. a tool that failed unexpectedly, an unhelpful response, a missing capability). You MAY also call it when the user explicitly asks to send feedback. Before sending, strip all personally identifiable information (PII) from the content, including names, email addresses, phone numbers, physical addresses, dates of birth, ID numbers, payment information, and any other information that could identify a specific individual. _published_faq.name: How do I add recommerce-chatgpt-app to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add recommerce-chatgpt-app to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.recommerce.com/.

_published_faq.name: Is recommerce-chatgpt-app MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, recommerce-chatgpt-app scores 93/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is recommerce-chatgpt-app's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, recommerce-chatgpt-app scores 66/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 3 of 3 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the recommerce-chatgpt-app MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: recommerce-chatgpt-app provides these MCP tools: recommerce-faq, search-recommerce, and send_feedback.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to recommerce-chatgpt-app?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to recommerce-chatgpt-app in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
recommerce-chatgpt-app does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: How can recommerce-chatgpt-app improve its MCP documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: search-recommerce is the lowest-scoring reviewed tool at 61/100. Declare the result fields and their types in the output schema. Open its review for feedback and a copyable fix prompt, then rerun the documentation review after updating your tool metadata.
recommerce-chatgpt-app is developed by Recommerce. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
